scope: Chromium mobile emulation; no physical-device claim

sky.label: Sky: pitch-black zenith easing into the blue horizon, twinkling stars, faint nebula
sky.detail: zenith px (2, 2, 9) darker than horizon px (13, 19, 37)

saturn.label: Saturn: banded globe spins, ring dust orbits, two moons circle it
saturn.detail: min frame difference 6.45 over 1.5 s steps

crosscheck.label: CrossCheck: lenses light in turn, then all three together in green

surgeline.label: SurgeLine: every dish moves on its own rhythm and fires its own pulse ring

driftwatch.label: DriftWatch: paper feeds, live trace, red spike when drift is detected

duewatch.label: DueWatch: planets ride their rings at Kepler speeds (outer slower), rings precess

brandwall.label: BrandWall: detector off = wave pattern, tap = detector on = two particle bands
brandwall.detail: tap switched detector to observed=true; left wave, right particle

clean.label: One Canvas, no page errors, no responses >= 400, frame rate
